result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, and statutory workers’ compensation, and requires certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings/counterparts provision. However, requiring every policy—including CGL and workers’ compensation—to remain in place for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored; any post-term requirement should generally address claims-made E&O/cyber coverage. The E&O and cyber limits also do not specify whether they are per claim or aggregate.
